initial_receipt.explanation: The downstream priority output has upstream_rank 0 for every need because the evidence_sources handoff uses source IDs as record_id values. The supplied function source for assemble_provenance constructs provenance rows with record_id set to record.get('source_id') instead of preserving the original need record_id. That corrupts the upstream provenance handoff, so job_2 cannot join ranks back to coverage records n06-r01 through n06-r08.

terminal_receipt.explanation: The two-job execution contains a provenance handoff fault. Job 2 received needs keyed by demand record IDs n06-r01 through n06-r08, but its evidence_sources handoff was keyed as s01 through s08. As a result, Job 2 could not match provenance ranks to coverage records and every priority row has upstream_rank 0. The captured upstream assemble_provenance source shows it writes record_id from source_id instead of preserving the demand record_id, which violates the criteria to preserve record identity and deterministic upstream provenance ordering.
